name: Droppah
description:
Connect Claude directly to your Droppah account and ask questions about your rosters, timesheets, and revenue.

With the Droppah connector, you can:

Check who's rostered, where, and when, across any team or date range

See rostered and actual wage costs, and compare the two

Spot no-shows or unrostered work before payroll runs

Compare wage cost against revenue by site or by day

Export your roster and timesheet data in any format including CSV, PDF or image

Learn more at droppah.com

_published_faq.name: How do I add Droppah to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Droppah to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://publicapi.droppah.com/droppah-public-api-mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Droppah MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Droppah provides these MCP tools: getPerson, getRevenue, getRoster, getRosterCost, getTeam, getTimesheet, getTimesheetCost, getWorkGroup, listPerson, listTeam, and listWorkGroup.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Droppah?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Droppah in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Droppah requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Droppah is developed by FlexiTime. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
